# ask-widget

> Lightweight, zero-dependency floating chat widget with Server-Sent Events (SSE) token streaming and neutral zinc aesthetics. Built for React 18 & 19 and modern developer portfolios.

Published as `@chitrank2050/ask-widget` on npm and JSR.

## Overview & Core Capabilities

- **Real-Time Token Streaming**: Built-in Server-Sent Events (SSE) reader for OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat` endpoints or custom async generator backends.
- **Zero Runtime Dependencies**: Completely self-contained React implementation under 14KB gzipped.
- **Neutral Zinc & Apple Aesthetics**: Default dark and light themes using CSS variables and `@layer` encapsulation to avoid host style collisions.
- **Headless Hooks**: Includes `useChat`, `useSSEStream`, and `useSession` for creating custom chat experiences without the default floating UI.
- **Next.js 16 & React 19 Ready**: Full ESM and CJS bundle exports with `'use client'` safety.

## Installation

```bash
# pnpm
pnpm add @chitrank2050/ask-widget

# npm
npm install @chitrank2050/ask-widget

# yarn
yarn add @chitrank2050/ask-widget
```

## Basic Usage (Next.js / React)

```tsx
import { ChatWidget } from '@chitrank2050/ask-widget';
import '@chitrank2050/ask-widget/style.css';

export function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html>
      <body>
        {children}
        <ChatWidget
          title="Portfolio Assistant"
          placeholder="Ask about my projects & background..."
          apiUrl={process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_API_URL}
          apiToken={process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_API_TOKEN}
          position="bottom-right"
          theme="dark"
        />
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

## Custom Streaming Generator

```tsx
import { ChatWidget, type ChatStreamHandler } from '@chitrank2050/ask-widget';
import '@chitrank2050/ask-widget/style.css';

const streamResponse: ChatStreamHandler = async function* (message, history) {
  const response = await fetch('/api/custom-chat', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ message, history }),
  });

  const reader = response.body?.getReader();
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();

  while (reader) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    yield decoder.decode(value);
  }
};

export function App() {
  return <ChatWidget streamResponse={streamResponse} />;
}
```

## Key Props Reference

- `apiUrl?: string`: Base URL of OpenAI-compatible chat backend. Automatically connects to `<apiUrl>/v1/chat`.
- `apiToken?: string`: Bearer authentication token.
- `position?: "bottom-right" | "bottom-left" | "bottom-center"`: Screen placement (default: `"bottom-right"`).
- `theme?: "dark" | "light"`: Visual theme (default: `"dark"`).
- `title?: string`: Header title (default: `"Ask AI"`).
- `placeholder?: string`: Input field placeholder.
- `initialMessage?: string`: Welcome message displayed in empty session.
- `streamResponse?: (message, history) => AsyncIterable<string>`: Custom generator for full streaming control.
- `labels?: ChatLabels`: Custom labels for `systemStatus`, `assistantTag`, `launcherLabel`.

## Headless Hooks

- `useChat(options)`: Core state engine managing messages, stream accumulation, text input, and reset.
- `useSSEStream(url, options)`: Server-Sent Events chunk reader with abort controller signal.
- `useSession(key, initial)`: Resilient localStorage hook with fallback for private browsing.
